title: CallSite
description: One resolved external API call expression in customer code. SPEC §5.1/§6.1/§8. Deliberately excludes owning-service/team and critical-path flag (need CODEOWNERS integration, not week 1) and any code snippet (SPEC §10 — no code retention beyond file path and line numbers).

surface.description: The canonical identity this call site resolves to.

commit_sha.description: Commit the extraction ran against. Null when indexing a working tree with uncommitted changes.

file_path.description: Path relative to the repository root.

api_version.description: Provider API version pinned at or around this call site (SPEC §6.1). Null when unpinned — most call sites, per spec.

value_binding.description: SPEC §6.1 resolution state. literal: statically resolved value. dynamic: argument present but assembled from config/env/variable. absent: not supplied; provider default applies.

confidence.description: Per-call-site confidence (SPEC §8.3). 1.0 for statically resolved typed SDK calls; lower for heuristic matches.

extractor.description: Which funnel stage resolved this call site, e.g. "tree_sitter.python", "tree_sitter.typescript". SPEC §8.1 — week 1 covers steps 1-2 only; no "embeddings"/"small_model"/"frontier_model" values yet.

file_content_hash.description: sha256 of the file's bytes at extraction time. SPEC §8.2 incremental re-indexing key.
